ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white) central pixels to low-intensity (black) peripheral and notch-area pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white regions on both lobes; thick black border along the trailing edge (wider on the right lobe); concentrated black pigmentation at the central peduncle junction; sparse black focal spots and mottling distributed across the white ventral field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 38 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations; left lobe shows micro-serrations (5-10 pixel amplitude); right lobe exhibits significant macro-notches and irregular jagged valleys (30-50 pixel amplitude).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature following an asymmetrical parabolic path toward the distal tips; distal tips are sharp and oriented slightly upward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular high-contrast pixel clusters (5-20 pixels in diameter) scattered across the white regions; dense clusters of high-intensity textured blobs (barnacles) on the left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel and intersecting linear disruptions; prominent diagonal rake marks on the lower left lobe; multiple horizontal scratches on the central and upper right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe; extensive barnacle colonization on both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Yellowish-tan linear staining or diatoms visible on the lower quadrant of the left lobe.
